about: The chain from 1984 to where we are. Dates are air dates, announcement dates or production dates, each with the source that carries it.

events.label: The Cosby Show premieres on NBC
events.note: The Huxtables, an upper-middle-class Black family in Brooklyn. 201 episodes over eight seasons; TV Guide called it TV's biggest hit of the 1980s and credited it with reviving the sitcom.

events.label: A Different World premieres on NBC
events.note: A spin-off of The Cosby Show, set at the fictional Hillman College — a historically Black college in Virginia — with Denise Huxtable (Lisa Bonet) as its lead. It will run 144 episodes over six seasons.

events.label: "If I Should Die Before I Wake" airs
events.note: A student discloses she is HIV-positive; a Black sitcom puts the AIDS crisis in prime time with Whoopi Goldberg and Tisha Campbell guest-starring.

events.label: The Cosby Show ends
events.note: The show that made the spin-off possible goes off the air.

events.label: Season six opens with the Rodney King verdict
events.note: "Honeymoon in L.A.": a conversation about the police-brutality trial sends Dwayne and Whitley back to their honeymoon during the Los Angeles riots, which continue into the next episode. Guest cast includes Sister Souljah.

events.label: A Different World ends
events.note: Six seasons, 144 episodes, cancelled with its characters only recently graduated.

events.label: Debbie Allen publicly calls for a reboot
events.note: Her tweets draw over a million reactions across Facebook, Twitter and blogs — the first documented push for this revival.

events.label: Deadline reports a Netflix sequel in development
events.note: A single-camera half-hour comedy about Whitley and Dwayne's daughter at Hillman, written and produced by Felicia Pride, with Debbie Allen, Tom Werner and Gina and Reggie Bythewood as executive producers.

events.label: Netflix orders a pilot
events.note: The revival moves from development to production.

events.label: Shooting in Atlanta
events.note: Principal photography runs February to May 2026.

events.label: The revival premieres on Netflix
events.note: Ten episodes, all released at once — exactly 39 years after the original's premiere date. Debbie Allen directs the first episode; Brandy performs the theme.

events.label: Renewed for a second season
events.note: Netflix orders season two eight days after release.
